artigo.titulo: Norfolk Island pine as a Christmas tree: care guide

legenda: A Norfolk Island pine can be your Christmas tree all year round. Give it the brightest window, keep it away from radiators and never leave the compost soggy.

beats.texto: You're making 3 mistakes with your Norfolk pine!
Relax! They're all easy to fix.
Mistake one: a dark corner. It wants the brightest window.
Mistake two: the radiator. Dry air turns the needles brown.
And the worst one? Soggy compost.
A lower branch that dies won't grow back.
So check the soil first. Water when the top is dry.
Water until it drains, then empty the saucer.
Every plant is different. There's an app that helps you care for yours.
Comment APP and I'll send you the link!
